html:
A Sahrawi nationalist movement founded on 10 May 1973 to end Spanish rule over Spanish Sahara, led at first by El-Ouali Mustapha Sayed.

It began a guerrilla war against Spain within days. When Spain handed the territory to Morocco and Mauritania in 1975, it turned to fight them in the Western Sahara War, with bases and arms from Algeria. In 1976 it proclaimed the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. It runs refugee camps near Tindouf in Algeria, where tens of thousands of Sahrawis have lived since 1975. It accepted a UN ceasefire in 1991 and calls for a vote on independence; it ended the ceasefire in 2020.
sum: A Sahrawi nationalist movement founded on 10 May 1973 to end Spanish rule over Spanish Sahara, led at first by El-Ouali Mustapha Sayed.
